services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: Step aboard your own private whale watching charter, where the experience is tailored just for you. With no crowds and no schedule but your own, you’ll have an up-close encounter with the ocean’s most majestic creatures in peaceful seclusion. Feel the exhilaration as the boat slices through open water, the world quiet but for the call of seabirds and the blow of a nearby whale. Whether you’re seeking quiet wonder or a bit of sea-spray adventure, our private charter offers an unforgettable, intimate connection with the wild beauty of the ocean. blurb: Guests board rigid hull inflatable boats (RHIBs) for intimate whale and dolphin watching tours along the Oceanside coast. Tours are led by certified naturalist captains who adjust routes based on wildlife activity. Sightings vary seasonally, including gray, blue, humpback, fin, and minke whales, plus dolphins nearly year-round.

quotes.author: Erin ORourke
quotes.text: Great trip on 1/3. No whales but LOTs of dolphin and a small shark! Capt Nate is a cool guy - explained what to look for and what we might see. The boat is awesome. Its nice to go out with a small group and being low in the water we were able to get an amazingly close view of the dolphin as they rode the bow wave - very cool experience! Would definitely recommend this tour

quotes.author: Heloise Mazzotti
quotes.text: We had an incredible experience with Nate during the past Thanksgiving weekend ! We had great weather and we saw two pods of dolphins. One more closer to the coast, the other much further out! Dolphins were playful! What a very fun experience ! Thank you Nate 😊🐬 can’t wait to come back to see more dolphins and maybe whales !?

quotes.author: L Huebert
quotes.text: Great whale watching experience. Small zodiac style boat got us up close. Three whales swam around and under our boat for more than 15 minutes. Close enough to get sprayed by the whale spout at one point. Our guide Nate was excellent. The tour far exceeded my expectations.

quotes.author: Anna R C. Shadow (Yadni)
quotes.text: So worth it! It was a fun yet relaxing experience, the zodiac boat was comfortable, for 6 people (7 including Captain Nate). We saw a gray whale and later “played” with the dolphins. Our girls loved the experience and can’t wait to do it again in Summer!
